messages.author: adc8ca6cfb4e05df
messages.subject: Put covariate effect on hyperparameter
parts: Hi, I'd like to model the effect of e.g. sex on the e.g. a Weibull distributed y. The sex is expected to change not only the scale \lambda but also the shape \alpha. Is it possible to put sex effect on the hyperparameter \alpha? please let me know if there a docs I should read. Thanks.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Put covariate effect on hyperparameter
parts:
Hi,

in this case, assuming sex is binary (without me having any opinion on
this issue!), then you could just use two likelihood models, for which
the shape will be different. you need to separate the data
wrt the value of sex

know how to do that?

H
